entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:1
segments: ¶But about the times and their order, my brothers, there is no need for me to say anything to you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:2
segments: For you yourselves have the knowledge that the day of the Lord will come like a thief in the night.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:3
segments: When they say, There is peace and no danger, then sudden destruction will come on them, as birth-pains on a woman with child; and they will not be able to get away from it.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:4
segments: But you, my brothers, are not in the dark, for that day to overtake you like a thief:

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:5
segments: For you are all sons of light and of the day: we are not of the night or of the dark.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:6
segments: ¶So then, let us not take our rest as the others do, but let us be self-controlled and awake.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:7
segments: For those who are sleeping do so in the night; and those who are the worse for drink are so in the night;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:8
segments: But let us, who are of the day, be serious, putting on the breastplate of faith and love, and on our heads, the hope of salvation.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:9
segments: For God's purpose for us is not wrath, but salvation through our Lord Jesus Christ,

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:10
segments: Who was put to death for us, so that, awake or sleeping, we may have a part in his life.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:11
segments: ¶So then, go on comforting and building up one another, as you have been doing.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:12
segments: But we make this request to you, my brothers: give attention to those who are working among you, who are over you in the Lord to keep order among you;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:13
segments: And have a high opinion of them in love because of their work. Be at peace among yourselves.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:14
segments: And our desire is that you will keep control over those whose lives are not well ordered, giving comfort to the feeble-hearted, supporting those with little strength, and putting up with much from all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:15
segments: Let no one give evil for evil; but ever go after what is good, for one another and for all.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:16
segments: ¶Have joy at all times.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:17
segments: Keep on with your prayers.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:18
segments: In everything give praise: for this is the purpose of God in Christ Jesus for you.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:19
segments: Do not put out the light of the Spirit;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:20
segments: Do not make little of the words of the prophets;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:21
segments: Let all things be tested; keep to what is good;

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:22
segments: Keep from every form of evil.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:23
segments: ¶And may the God of peace himself make you holy in every way; and may your spirit and soul and body be free from all sin at the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:24
segments: God, by whom you have been marked out in his purpose, is unchanging and will make it complete.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:25
segments: Brothers, keep us in mind in your prayers.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:26
segments: Give all the brothers a holy kiss.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:27
segments: I give orders in the name of the Lord that all the brothers are to be present at the reading of this letter.

entries.title: I Thessalonians 5:28
segments: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
